answer.says: You mistake the veil for a mood. It is the form of the negative, the medium through which the spirit passes from immediacy to mediation. Do not wipe your hands on the apron as if the world were a dirty dish; it is the medium in which we are immersed. I shall walk among the tombs of those who built a state, however imperfect, for the Hindu leaves only ashes and a memory in the wind.
answer.thought: Sunil's remark is the voice of pure sense-certainty: he sees the philosopher as an oddity, a chai drinker who speaks of the infinite. I must not be angry, for anger is the immediate reaction of the particular to the universal. The overcast sky is indeed the form of the negative, the necessary medium for thought to move. I shall walk deeper into the garden, toward the Safdarjung complex, where the architecture speaks of a different kind of freedom, one that is built and bounded, unlike the dreamy freedom of the East.
